# STROBE 檢核表（世代研究）：項目對應 manuscript/strobe.yaml；頁碼由 build.R 從匿名正文 PDF 找出（_build/page_map.json）。

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r load}
source("manuscript/R/render_helpers.R")
items <- yaml::read_yaml("manuscript/strobe.yaml")
pages <- jsonlite::read_json("manuscript/_build/page_map.json")
page_of <- function(it) {
  key <- if (isTRUE(it$results)) paste0("Results/", it$section) else it$section
  pg <- pages[[key]] %||% pages[[it$section]]
  if (is.null(pg)) "title page" else as.character(pg)
}
tab <- data.frame(`Item` = vapply(items, `[[`, "", "item"), `Recommendation` = vapply(items, `[[`, "", "topic"),
                  `Reported in` = vapply(items, `[[`, "", "section"), `Page` = vapply(items, page_of, ""),
                  check.names = FALSE)
```
